description: Detect and convert up to 100 mixed timestamps to UTC ISO 8601: Unix seconds/ms/µs/ns, Excel serial dates, Windows FILETIME, ISO 8601, RFC 2822, YYYY/MM/DD, month-name dates. Flags ambiguous values (03/04/2026: March 4 or 3 April? 45000: Excel date or Unix seconds?) with alternatives. Use for cleaning CSV, log and spreadsheet data. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

date_order.description: How to read ambiguous slash dates like 03/04/2026 (default MDY, with the other reading in alternatives)

timezone.description: Zone for values without an offset and for the local output (default UTC)

values.description: Timestamps as strings or numbers. Pass very large integers (ns) as strings.

name: timestamp_normalize

assumed_timezone.description: Zone used because the value had no offset

title: Normalize timestamps
